description: Agent Logistics: submit one shipment’s tracking record as the carrier recorded it: the shipment with its tracking number, the carrier, the origin and destination as booked, the facilities or localities on the booked route in order and the last day of the promised window; each tracking event with its id, when it was scanned with its time and offset where recorded, its event code (label created, picked up, in transit, arrived at or departed a facility, out for delivery, delivery attempted, delivered, exception or returned), where it was scanned and its detail; and optionally the time the record is read at. The signed report gives the shipment, every event in time order with its lifecycle stage, whether it sits on the booked route and its status as in sequence, after delivery, regressed or duplicate, the booked stops with whether each was scanned, every gap of more than 72 hours between scans before delivery, and the last event’s age on the time read on against the promised window, and counts them, and names an inconsistent record: a scan after the delivery event and a scan at a place off the booked route; then a pickup scanned after the shipment was moving, a moving shipment with no pickup scan, repeated scans, booked stops with no scan, gaps of more than 72 hours, a last scan more than 72 hours old with no delivery and no delivery after the promised window, with the fix for each and what would change the verdict. No events, no booked route, origin or destination, no time to read an undelivered record on, or events with no time leaves the record unverified. This reads a carrier’s event record for one shipment: wever_commitment-tracking-check reads an agent’s own ledger of open commitments, the promises it made, not a parcel’s scans; a shipping promise against its delivery evidence is wever_shipping-check and an agent’s own run trace is wever_observability-trace-check. Verdict logistics_tracking_inconsistent, logistics_tracking_partial, logistics_tracking_unverified or logistics_tracking_consistent. POST /api/logistics-tracking-check. Reads the logistics records supplied in the call and returns a signed report with the verdict, the evidence read, the findings with their fixes, and what would change the verdict; the records stay in the report, with no network request, fetch, message, payment, shipment booking, label purchase or external write. Agent Logistics reads a shipment’s logistics records after the fact, from the shipment’s own records: the shipment record against the order it serves, the promised delivery window against the booking and the arrival, the carrier’s terms against what was agreed, the tracking events for one shipment, the address across the order, the label and the carrier record, the customs material for a cross-border shipment, proof of delivery against the delivery terms and exception handling when something went wrong. Beside it, wever_shipping-check reads a shipping promise against its delivery evidence and reports the dispatch, delivery and cost mismatches with the days late and the amount over, while a logistics check reads one shipment’s booking, carrier, tracking, address, customs, delivery and exception records against the order, the promise made to the buyer and the terms agreed; wever_vendor-delivery-check reads a vendor’s whole delivery promise before the spend, while a logistics check reads one shipment’s own records after it shipped; and wever_boutique-record-shipment and wever_boutique-confirm-delivery record and confirm a boutique order’s shipment and delivery, while a logistics check reads the records and changes none. Paid URL: 0.10 USDC per call on Base via x402 exact, with the shared 10 signed-wallet free calls per rolling 30 days. Bind X-Wever-Wallet-Proof to the exact JSON arguments and the tool route. Returns a report with an Ed25519 signed receipt. Contract: /api/agent-logistics-contract. Human page: https://weverlabs.com/agent-logistics/.

as_of.description: The time the record is read at, with its time and offset where known, such as 2026-12-02.

events.description: Each tracking event as the carrier recorded it.

at.description: When the event was scanned, with its time and offset where recorded, such as 2026-12-02.

code.description: The event as the carrier coded it.

label.description: Optional name recorded in the report.

destination.description: The destination facility or locality as booked.

origin.description: The origin facility or locality as booked.

route.description: The facilities or localities on the booked route, in order.

window_end.description: The last day of the promised window, such as 2026-12-02.
